context: Yuki and Naoko look at recorded memories together.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 直子さん、海外の記録、見て。
lines.en: Naoko-san, look at this — I got photos from overseas.
lines.style: Warm, inviting opening. Bright but genuine, not performative. A soft lift on 「海外の記録」 like she's excited to share something real with someone she trusts. Gentle throughout.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Oh wow — so many memories in there.
lines.style: Immediate warmth, nostalgic. Slow down slightly on 「思い出」, like the weight of them lands. Soft, appreciative tone. The tenderness of someone being included in looking back.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: パリの街、本当、綺麗だった。
lines.en: Paris was really beautiful — the streets, I mean.
lines.style: Soften the voice here. Reminiscing, almost to herself, but letting Naoko in. A small pause before 「綺麗だった」, like she's living it again. Tender, not performative.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: I wish I'd gone with you.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine longing. No performance. Just the straightforward wish, landing soft. A beat of tenderness — not sadness, just the real feeling of wanting to have been there.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 友達と、楽しい、また、行こう。
lines.en: We should go again sometime — with friends. It'll be fun.
lines.style: Brightness returns, but grounded. A promise threaded through, not forced enthusiasm. Small, genuine warmth. Closing door gently open to the future.
